title: Best of Saie Mini Vanity Case Vault
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Vegan
What it is: A holiday vault filled with Saie’s bestsellers, featuring six full-size products and two minis, packed in a new, limited-edition brown Mini Vanity Case.

What Else You Need to Know: Create your own SaieGlow with these bestsellers: start with Glowy Super Gel, add a touch of flush with Dew Blush, build your eye with SuperSuede Eyeshadow and Mascara 101, create your lip combo with Lip Liner 101 and Glossybounce, and set your look with CitySet Setting Spray.

This Set Contains:
- Mini Vanity Case
- Dual-Ended Eyeshadow Brush
- 0.03 oz/ 0.9 g SuperSuede Baked Eyeshadow in Gelato
- 0.40 oz/ 11.34 g Dew Blush in Sweetie
- 0.31 oz/ 8.8 g Mascara 101 in Black
- 0.05 oz/ 1.4 g Lip Liner 101 in Flirt
- 0.1
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply 1-2 pumps of Glowy Super Gel as your forever first step for a lit-from-within glow.
-Add a dewy wash of color with Dew Blush.
-Using The Double Eyeshadow Brush, create a shimmery eye with SuperSuede Eyeshadow.
-Coat lashes with Mascara 101.
-Frame lips with Lip Liner 101 and smudge with fingertips.
-Swipe on Glossybounce Lip Gloss Oil for juicy, defined lips.
-Set the full look for 16 hours with CitySet Lightweight Setting Spray.
-To clean your Vanity Case, remove the interior organizer, wipe down with damp cloth, and let air dry. Store and handle with care. Keep away from liquids and oils.
Ingredients+

Supersuede Eyeshadow – Gelato:
Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Mica, Squalane, Octyldodecanol, Jojoba Esters, Hectorite, Silica, Ethylhexylglycerin, Kaolin, Potassium Sorbate, Alumina, Boron Nitride, Cellulose, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Tin Oxide, Ceramide Np, Tocopherol [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (Ci 77163), Chromium Oxide Greens (Ci 77288)].

Dew Blush – Sweetie:
Isocetyl Stearoyl Stearate, Glycerin, Tribehenin, Sambucus Nigra (Elderberry) Fruit Extract, Mica, Glyceryl Stearate, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Silica, Morus Alba (White Mulberry) Root Extract, Symphytum Officinale (Comfrey) Leaf Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Root Extract. [+/- May Contain/ Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide Ci77891, Iron Oxides (Ci77492, Ci77491, Ci77499), Yellow 6 Lake, Red 7 Lake, Red 22 Lake, Ferric Ferrocyanide].

Mascara 101 – Black:
Isocetyl Stearoyl Stearate, Glycerin, Tribehenin, Sambucus Nigra (Elderberry) Fruit Extract, Mica, Glyceryl Stearate, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Silica, Morus Alba (White Mulberry) Root Extract, Symphytum Officinale (Comfrey) Leaf Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Root Extract. [+/- May Contain/ Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide Ci77891, Iron Oxides (Ci77492, Ci77491, Ci77499), Yellow 6 Lake, Red 7 Lake, Red 22 Lake, Ferric Ferrocyanide].

Lip Liner 101 – Flirt:
Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Mica, Mangifera Indica (Mango) Seed Oil, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax/Euphorbia Cerifera Cera/Cire De Candelilla, Silica, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera/Cire De Carnauba, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Ascorbyl Palmitate. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Yellow 5 Lake (Ci 19140), Red 6 (Ci 15850)].

Glossybounce – Shake:
Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Oleic/Linoleic/Linolenic Polyglycerides, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera/Cire De Carnauba, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Silica, Mica, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf/Stem Extract, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Sodium Hyaluronate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Aqua/Water/Eau, Caprylyl Glycol, Sorbitan Oleate. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 7 (Ci 15850), Yellow 6 Lake (Ci 15985)].

Mini Cityset:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Propanediol, Hydrolyzed Corn Starch, Pentylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Glycerin, Citric Acid, Citrus Reticulata (Tangerine) Peel Extract, Glycogen, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Sodium Hydroxide.

Mini Glowy Super Gel – Warmglow:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Glycerin, Mica, Squalane, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Polysorbate 60, Sorbitan Isostearate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tocopherol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Lactic Acid. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491)].


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
